bullet: Switch to an edited profile (`F09.switch-profile-edited`), known bug.
script:
trap 'control-agent-server api DELETE /api/profiles/qa-f09-edit >/dev/null' EXIT
EID=$(control-agent-server conversation start --placeholder-agent --tools none --no-autotitle --print-id)
control-agent-server api POST /api/profiles/qa-f09-edit --json '{"llm": {"model": "openai/qa-f09-edit-1", "api_key": "sk-qa-f09-edit", "base_url": "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1"}}' --expect 201
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$EID/switch_profile" --json '{"profile_name": "qa-f09-edit"}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$EID" --quiet --check agent.llm.model eq openai/qa-f09-edit-1
control-agent-server api POST /api/profiles/qa-f09-edit --json '{"llm": {"model": "openai/qa-f09-edit-2", "api_key": "sk-qa-f09-edit", "base_url": "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1"}}' --expect 201
control-agent-server api GET /api/profiles/qa-f09-edit --quiet --check config.model eq openai/qa-f09-edit-2
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$EID/switch_profile" --json '{"profile_name": "qa-f09-edit"}' --expect 200 --save F09.switch-profile-edited/switch-again
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$EID" --quiet --check agent.llm.model eq openai/qa-f09-edit-2 --save F09.switch-profile-edited/get  # bug
failed_command: control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$EID" --quiet --check agent.llm.model eq openai/qa-f09-edit-2 --save F09.switch-profile-edited/get
